prague-bohemia-orlick-mountains-sweep.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Treat High point near Řevnice → Near Rudná as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

sections.to: Photo stop near Roudnice nad Labem
sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Slaný → Photo stop near Roudnice nad Labem is the reward section in Prague. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.from: Photo stop near Roudnice nad Labem
sections.advice: Photo stop near Roudnice nad Labem → Pečky, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Food stop near Kouřim → Back to Orlické Mountains is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
